races.verdict: MY CUBBY BEAR returned to form when second in a 6f handicap at Cork last week and may well be up to going one better back in maiden company, especially if the standard-setter Almeiyda underperforms once again. Lilli's Angel has a progressive profile which must count for something in an ordinary race, while Port Arthur is another who merits consideration. MY CUBBY BEAR (IRE) ALMEIYDA (IRE) LILLI'S ANGEL (IRE)
